question: If you are facing east and move 10 meters, then turn to your left and move 5 meters. Which direction are you facing now?
solution:
Given:

You are facing east and move 10 meters, then turn to your left and move 5 meters.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c389bf4b5bd7bd2da3176e8a5f7eeaaf31ad1f1570f5e55e9c44e2cfd5ca8f06.png] 

Thus, facing in the north direction now.

Hence, **"Option 2"** is the correct answer.
